project_overview: This project appears to be a web application, likely for an educational institution, focusing on student management and academic processes. The codebase demonstrates a layered architecture with components for user authentication, data management, and displaying information related to students, exams, and programs. Initial review reveals significant architectural concerns including circular dependencies and potential security vulnerabilities. The code exhibits a high level of complexity, indicating a need for architectural refinement and improved maintainability.

layers.description: Handles user interface and interactions. Contains a variety of Vue components responsible for rendering different views and managing user input.
Contains the core application logic and interactions between the presentation and data layers. Includes routing, API calls, and state management.
Interacts with external APIs or data sources to fetch and store data. Details are incomplete but likely utilizes HTTP requests for data retrieval.

macro_trends.title: Circular Dependencies - Critical
macro_trends.description: Multiple files (e.g., main.js, router.js, and related components) exhibit circular dependency chains. This can lead to unpredictable behavior, difficult debugging, and potential performance issues. Refactoring is urgently needed to break these cycles.

macro_trends.title: Prop Drilling - High Risk
macro_trends.description: Deep prop drilling between Vue components suggests a potential lack of appropriate state management solutions. This could lead to code duplication, reduced maintainability, and difficulties in scaling the application. Employing Vuex or Pinia for centralized state management is highly recommended.

key_workflows.name: User Authentication Workflow
key_workflows.description: The flow involves user login, potentially storing authentication tokens, and utilizing them for subsequent API requests. This workflow is heavily reliant on 'adminLogin.vue' and related routing, and requires careful attention to security best practices regarding token management and storage.

key_workflows.name: Student Data Retrieval and Display Workflow
key_workflows.description: This involves fetching student data from an external source (likely via API calls), transforming it into a suitable format, and displaying it within various Vue components. There are concerns regarding how this data is accessed and managed within the components.
